Over the last 25 sessions there were 9 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 4 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-2.0%) came on light volume.
RSI is 40 (neutral); MACD is below its signal line since Oct 13.
A daily close above $649.66 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $623.40 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
